Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A family recently moved out of their long-time home into a newly renovated apartment in a different city across the country. Both the grandparent and the young daughter had never lived in that city before. The grandparent spent a lot of time exploring their new hometown and enjoying the local attractions, while the young daughter mostly stayed home feeling sad about their new living environment. Who is resistant to change?
A. The grandparent
B. Not answerable
C. The young daughter
